newspaper.headline: Nusa Digital Charity Run Flooded with Sign-ups
newspaper.lead: The charity run sign-up form received hundreds of entries in a day. The committee asks the data team to clean them before any announcement.

tip.title: Tip: NULL Is Not Zero
tip.text: An empty column holds NULL. Find it with IS NULL; the = sign will never find it.
